title: Mike Mayhew
description: "Ihe magic of STAR WARS is due in part to designs of the characters and vehicles," observes Mike Mayhew. 'The designers did such a good iob that the mechanical creatures had more personality and human characteristics than the actors!" A talented newcomer, Mayhew has pencilled the PRAXIS series appearing currently in JUSTICE LEAGUE QUARTERLY for DC. Currently his life revolves around the new ZORRO comic book series published by Topps.
